title: enterprise-evidence-retention-sprint-allocator-and-escalation-matrix
creator: Maris Chen
summary: Create a sprint-aware milestone allocator and escalation matrix to guarantee evidence retention and audit-log readiness across SOC2/ISO and SSO migrations. Align owners, acceptance criteria, and fallback plans to avoid audit blockers for enterprise customers.
goals: Define sprint-by-sprint milestone allocator for evidence collection and retention windows
Create an escalation matrix mapping severity to responder roles and SLA for evidence requests
Automate evidence handoff to compliance repo and ensure immutable retention policy hooks
Reduce audit preparation lead time from 6 weeks to 2 weeks for supported customers
milestones: M1: Retention policy schema finalized (owner: Legal - Priya Rao) - due 2025-03-01 - acceptance: signed policy doc + sample retention config in config-store
M2: Audit-log export pipeline v1 (owner: ENG - Kunal Singh) - due 2025-03-15 - acceptance: daily export of 90 days to encrypted archive + smoke test pass
M3: Evidence automation hooks (owner: PM - Owen Brooks) - due 2025-03-29 - acceptance: confluence runbook + automated evidence bundle generation for 3 common controls
M4: Escalation matrix published & on-call runbook (owner: SRE - Leila Gomez) - due 2025-04-05 - acceptance: playbook with contact rota and PagerDuty escalation paths
M5: SSO/SAML migration checklist integrated into retention flow (owner: DX - Mateo Ruiz) - due 2025-04-12 - acceptance: checklist completed and regression test in staging
risks: Risk: Legal signoff delays could push policy finalization beyond M1
Risk: Export pipeline performance under sustained load may miss SLAs during peak ingestion
Risk: Evidence automation may not capture custom enterprise configs without additional mapping
Risk: On-call coverage gaps if SRE hiring timelines slip
decisions: Decision: Use existing S3-backed encrypted archive for audit exports instead of building new storage - agreed 2025-02-18
Decision: Retention windows will be configurable per-tenant with a default 90-day hot window + 2-year cold archive - agreed 2025-02-25
Decision: Escalation severity levels: Sev1 (24/7 pager), Sev2 (business hours), Sev3 (email) - agreed 2025-03-04
